purpose: Track recorded consumables, service events, projected duty-adjusted remaining life and replacement economics for the selected vehicle, with explicit evidence and safety limitations.
primaryGoal: Understand which recorded part needs attention, inspect the assumptions behind its projection, and record a part or service event without mistaking modelled wear for a physical measurement.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Hand-styled lifecycle and event-editor surfaces repeat fixed-white border/background patterns at lines 345 and 778; the direct EvidencePanel dependency repeats one at line 129.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Use existing neutral surface/border tokens or existing card composition; do not create another consumable card visual system.

responsive.detail: Part register mobileColumns retains label/installed/retired only. Actions are the sole Log event and Remove entry points at lines 316-337. DataTable.tsx:725 adds hidden md:table-cell to excluded columns; no mobilePresentation or alternate action path is supplied. Source indicates these actions and rated-life/cost columns disappear below md.
responsive.fix: Adopt existing complete mobile table presentation retaining part identity, rated life, currency/cost, retirement and accessible Log event/Remove actions; test both narrow allocated containers and viewport widths without losing table pipeline behavior.

responsive.detail: Duty-cycle table hides the reference baseline on mobile while retaining observed value and multiplier. That removes the explicit comparison needed to interpret the explanatory projection.
responsive.fix: Retain baseline, SI unit and narrative through the existing mobile detail/summary strategy, not a shortened data model.

responsive.detail: Lifecycle outer header wraps, but its nested label/verdict/harsh-duty flex row at line 351 does not wrap or declare min-w-0. Long user part names and translated badges can pressure narrow widths. Forms do stack below md; numeric detail grid reflows at md/xl.
responsive.fix: Allow nested title/status reflow and safe word wrapping while preserving all labels. Verify 320/375/390/430 widths, long names, currency strings and expanded histories rather than asserting overflow from source alone.

accessibility.detail: Remaining-life visual bar is nested divs without meter/progress semantics or aria-hidden. Text percentage and VerdictBadge provide non-color state, but no programmatic association identifies the bar as a projected, not physically measured, remaining-life value.
accessibility.fix: Keep textual projection/status and either mark the redundant bar decorative or use an existing accessible measurement presentation with a localized projection label and unknown-value handling. Do not imply maintenance completion progress.

accessibility.detail: Inline event editor opens from a table action but has no visible selected-part heading, editor-region label or explicit focus transfer. Fields are labelled and Cancel exists, but target context is only eventFor state; tab/focus recovery is not demonstrated.
accessibility.fix: Expose the selected part name and associate an editor heading/region, using existing focus conventions; verify keyboard reachability and focus restoration without inventing another overlay system.

accessibility.detail: Category names are generated by replacing underscores in source enum keys at lines 251, 361 and 665 rather than localized labels. Binding-limit text also interpolates the raw key at line 452. Event kinds already have a localized mapping at lines 70-76.
accessibility.fix: Use existing canonical catalog/domain label ownership for category and binding-limit display; preserve exact enum values on wire and in filters. Report any needed catalog entries to their owner.

loading.detail: Initial reads receive section loading shells; preserveSummary keeps raw-missing summary metrics and the OperationalBrief loading contract. No project-wide spinner replaces all page content by page-local condition.

empty.detail: Projection explains recording a part; stress explains insufficient drives; register retains Record part action in panel chrome. Empty and missing report keep summary values unknown rather than measured zero.

fatalError.detail: Fatal read error is section-local with retry. Register editor policy can keep unsaved editing usable without successful initial read. Actual mounted PageContainer behavior was not inspected.

retainedRefreshErrorAndOffline.detail: Shared data state retains payload for refresh errors/paused reads; domain adapter maps stale to retained, with warning and retry. This adapter does not distinguish explicit offline copy from retained refresh failure. No disconnected-browser exercise.

unknownAndPartial.detail: Nullable rated/adjusted/remaining distance, remaining duration, forecast date and rate use dashes/null raw metrics. Arrays default empty. Quality exposes reasons/coverage/evidence. health_pct and duty values are non-null typed inputs; do not reinterpret backend unknown projections as zero or assume physical wear.
unknownAndPartial.limitations: EvidencePanel sample_count fallback is 0 when a quality object exists; no nullable backend contract was reviewed to call this incorrect. Page does not add explicit partial-query status beyond independent section sources.

writes.detail: Save/event/delete pending states, inline write errors, global mutation toasts and destructive confirmation exist. Part form closes without resetting draft; successful event resets eventDraft. Cancellation closes editors without clearing drafts. No write executed.

visualIssues.detail: Health percentage uses raw p with text-lg/font-semibold; detail values at 396, 412, 428 and 440 use ad-hoc text-sm paragraphs instead of role typography. Existing Text is already used throughout the same card.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing Text/MetricValue roles while retaining tabular numbers and semantic projection emphasis. Measure actual composed contrast for toned emerald/amber/rose text in every supported theme.

visualIssues.detail: Both DataTables sit inside OwnershipPanel but omit variant, whose inspected default is standalone (DataTable.tsx:452). Lifecycle cards also nest two separate StatGrid Cards per part. Repeated frames and duplicated long safety copy in the overview may dilute projection hierarchy; rendered intensity is unverified.
visualIssues.fix: Prefer existing embedded table variant where panel owns the frame and tune composition/spacing with current tokens. Keep every cost, caveat and explanation; do not flatten away evidence or history to reduce card count.

visualIssues.detail: Shared evidence tiles use fixed-white border/background, independently of current theme tokens. Page has two analogous sites recorded under duplicatedPatterns. No neon/glow/shadow source matches were found on this page; bright appearance is not established.
visualIssues.fix: EvidencePanel owner should replace its fixed-white surface with existing neutral tokens while retaining quality, evidence timestamps and limitation text; no palette or theme-provider change.

architectureIssues.detail: Event MoneyInput uses report?.currency ?? draft.currency at line 812, while displayed per-item/event-history money uses the selected item's currency (lines 305, 462 and 505). Mixed-currency entries can therefore show an event cost-entry hint in a different currency from its part. Backend currency interpretation is unverified; event request carries no currency.
architectureIssues.fix: Resolve selected-item currency as the event editor's source contract and verify backend semantics before implementation. Preserve raw minor-unit values and report-level economics currency; do not introduce currency conversion or silently relabel prior amounts.

architectureIssues.detail: eventFor is only an item ID. Opening an event from a table row does not store the owning vehicle or part identity; no page-local effect/reset/guard compares it with a subsequently changed workspace vehicle before submitEvent at line 170. Reads do scope correctly. Cross-vehicle editor context is a source risk, not a proven wrong write.
architectureIssues.fix: Bind editor target to selected item/vehicle and safely close or mark invalid on scope changes before allowing a real write; preserve drafts intentionally and test no accidental maintenance submission to a previously selected vehicle.

architectureIssues.detail: 906-line orchestrator includes inline lifecycle/history rendering (341-520), column definitions, both forms, draft state and submit adapters. Typed hooks and existing formatters are already separated; only one component is exported, and no direct legacy API/library pattern was found.
architectureIssues.fix: If modernization needs decomposition, extract bounded ownership feature renderers/forms with typed props and callbacks, preserving the whole feature-directory count and every capability. Keep mutations in the existing hook layer and avoid a parallel global component library.

dataBehavior: Raw metres/seconds survive API, drafts and requests. SI numeric entry remains metres with preferred-display hints; rated days are explicitly converted to seconds on submit, nullable absence preserved.

ISO install dates use existing UTC-midnight fromDateInput/toDateInput round trip; event occurrence is submission time. These are independent maintenance business dates, not a missing workspace range selector.

Minor-unit integer money and each part's currency survive. Rate displays remain explicitly per 1 000 metres, with current rounding at display only; do not replace with per-mile rates or invent currency conversion.
Six posture metrics retain due soon, overdue, next replacement, next twelve-month cost, spent to date and average stress; three economics metrics retain blended rate, odometer and tracked part count.

Each projection retains label/category/position, status and harsh-duty signal, textual remaining-life percentage and clamped visual bar, distance used/rated percentage, adjusted life/stress, remaining metres/seconds, projected date, binding limit and narrative.
Per-part replacement cost and wear rate remain; preview badges are capped at six but Accordion exposes every event with kind/date/nullable odometer/cost/note.

Duty-cycle factors deduplicate by code using the first encountered factor; observed/reference SI values, source units, multipliers and narratives remain. Do not change compounding/clamping or create model calculations.
Register retains label/category/position, installed instant/odometer, rated metres/seconds, cost/currency, retired/in-service state, Log event and Remove, including mobile reachability.

Arrays remain null-safe; nullable quantities/rates/dates use dashes or null metrics rather than zero. Draft zero values are entry defaults, not measured values. Default rated_life_m=60000, currency=USD and event kind=inspect remain unless separately authorized.
Read keys, positive-vehicle enablement, AbortSignal, inherited cache/retry policies and ownership-wide write invalidation/toasts remain. No duplicate server state or manual fetch layer.

Preserve report as_of versus client load time, unknown analysis bounds, quality status/reasons/samples/coverage/window, evidence source/summary/samples/time and unsupported physical wear/recall caveats.
No per-page export callback is configured. Preserve existing table controls and export semantics if enabled by that shared pipeline; do not invent a server export or financial submission.
Table IDs ownership-consumables-stress and ownership-consumables-items remain stable. Actual lazy/SafeRoute registration is at App.tsx:251,783; route reachability was not exercised.
